content.text: hemolytic anemia due to autoantibody production against RBCs
: numbness or mottling of the fingers, toes, nose, ears that resolves w/ warming up of the body parts
RBCs become deficient in GPI anchor surface proteins
lead to increased complement activation & intravascular RBC destruction
during the night or early morning
- allogenic hematopoietic cell transplant only potential for cure
